title: Microsoft Teams: external presenters in event group chat
summary: Hold: the statement that Microsoft has not said where these chat messages are held overlooks its published Teams chat storage and federated-user retention guidance. The rollout dates and PowerShell calls are supported; the policy navigation paths and explanation of external-access precedence need small clarifications.

claims.quote: This change enables presenters who are outside the tenant hosting the meeting or event to participate in the event group chat.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented the specific effects of the tenantId correction on this chat's audit or retention records.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams external presenter event group chat tenantId audit retention storage join verification external access policy. Read MC1528011, manage-event-chat and retention-policies-teams; general federated retention is documented, but the tenantId correction's specific effects are not.

claims.claim: The event-chat article excludes event group chat from its organiser-mailbox storage description.
claims.quote: Meeting chat messages in events optimized for large audiences, excluding the event group chat, are stored only in an organizer's mailbox for up to 30 days.

claims.where: Open questions: audit, retention and storage
claims.claim: Where event group-chat messages are held is not stated by Microsoft.
claims.quote: Teams uses an Azure-powered chat service as its primary storage for all messages (chats and channel messages).
claims.fix: Remove the blanket conclusion 'so where those messages are held is not stated'. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/retention-policies-teams for general Teams storage: primary Azure-powered chat storage and compliance copies in participant mailboxes; external users from another Microsoft 365 organisation have their copies in their own tenant. MC1528011 explicitly says existing federated-chat handling applies. Keep only the narrower open question about the tenantId correction's specific audit or retention effects; do not apply the attendee-chat 30-day rule to event group chat.

claims.claim: Attendees do not use the event group chat.
